o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish سلام (selām), from Arabic سَلَام (salām).
From Proto-Common Turkic. According to Dybo, the Proto-Turkic *yayŋak is reconstructable. Cognate with Turkish yanak, etc.
From Arabic تَصْنِيفات (taṣnīfāt), from Arabic تَصْنِيف (taṣnīf).
